data.Q: Why does the man ask his sons to bury him beside the man of God?
data.A: Because the man of God’s message from the Lord is sure to happen.
data.wrong_answer: Because he has just buried the man of God.

data.Q: Who declares the message that is sure to happen?
data.wrong_answer: The man who speaks to his sons.

data.Q: Where is the altar opposed by the message?
When does the man want his sons to bury him beside the man of God?
data.wrong_answer: After he buries the man of God.
